name: Odric, Lunarch Marshal — trigger emits no static keyword grants
notes: Memory: project_odric_duplicant_same_is_true_2026-05-25 and project_odric_trigger_visibility_and_keyword_substring_fix_2026-05-25. The 'same is true for' expansion and the trailing-if stripper must skip the At the beginning of each combat sentence: Odric alone has no static add_ability effects and keeps his triggered ability line, so Grizzly Bears (and Akroma, whose keywords Odric's own text enumerates) gain nothing without the trigger firing.

$includes: At the beginning of each combat, creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn if a creature you control has first strike. The same is true for flying, deathtouch, double strike, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, skulk, trample, and vigilance.
